templates.name: Dockhand by HTTP
templates.description: Dockhand monitoring template for Zabbix 7.4. Combines Dockhand API/event monitoring with local Docker Engine and Dockhand application-container monitoring through Zabbix Agent 2. Requires Zabbix Agent 2 with the Docker plugin on the Dockhand host and the agent user must have access to the Docker socket. The local Dockhand container name is controlled by {$DOCKHAND.LOCAL.CONTAINER.NAME}.

items.name: Local Docker engine: Containers running
items.description: Number of running containers on the local Docker host.

items.name: Local Docker engine: Containers stopped
items.description: Number of stopped containers on the local Docker host.

items.name: Local Docker engine: Containers total
items.description: Total number of containers on the local Docker host.

items.name: Local Docker engine: Images total
items.description: Total number of Docker images including intermediate layers.

triggers.name: Dockhand host: Local Docker engine is down
triggers.description: The Docker daemon on the Dockhand host is not reachable through the Zabbix Agent 2 Docker plugin.

items.name: Dockhand raw event
items.description: Receives raw Dockhand notification events through the Zabbix history.push API. This item is the primary event stream used for immediate container, environment, health, vulnerability, and lifecycle notifications.

triggers.expression: last(/Dockhand by HTTP/dockhand.local.container.error,#1)<>last(/Dockhand by HTTP/dockhand.local.container.error,#2) and length(last(/Dockhand by HTTP/dockhand.local.container.error))>0
triggers.name: Dockhand application container reported an error
triggers.description: Docker reported a non-empty error string for the local Dockhand application container.

triggers.name: Dockhand application container was OOM-killed
triggers.description: The local Dockhand application container was killed due to an out-of-memory condition.

items.name: Dockhand application container: Present
items.description: Whether the local Dockhand application container named by {$DOCKHAND.LOCAL.CONTAINER.NAME} exists in the local Docker Engine.

triggers.name: Dockhand application container is missing
triggers.description: The local Docker Engine is reachable, but the Dockhand application container "{$DOCKHAND.LOCAL.CONTAINER.NAME}" is not present.

dependencies.name: Dockhand host: Local Docker engine is down

triggers.name: Dockhand application container: Restart loop detected
triggers.description: The local Dockhand application container restarted at least {$DOCKHAND.RESTART.COUNT} times within {$DOCKHAND.RESTART.WINDOW}.

triggers.name: Dockhand application container is not running
triggers.description: The local Dockhand application container exists but is not running.

dependencies.name: Dockhand host: Local Docker engine is down

discovery_rules.name: Discover containers in {#ENV.NAME}
discovery_rules.description: Discovers containers managed by the Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}" through the /api/containers endpoint. Containers explicitly configured with the dockhand.notify=false label are excluded. Supports both unauthenticated Dockhand installations and installations protected by a bearer API token.

trigger_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Exited
trigger_prototypes.description: Container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}" exited unexpectedly. The problem remains open until the container is started or restarted.

trigger_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Out of memory
trigger_prototypes.description: Container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}" was terminated due to an out-of-memory condition. The problem remains open until the container is started or restarted.

trigger_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Stopped
trigger_prototypes.description: Container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}" was stopped. The problem remains open until the container is started or restarted.

trigger_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Unhealthy
trigger_prototypes.description: Container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}" reported an unhealthy health status. The problem remains open until Dockhand reports container_healthy for the same container.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Event
item_prototypes.description: Filtered raw Dockhand notification event for container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in environment "{#ENV.NAME}". Events are selected from the global dockhand.event stream by environment ID and container name.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Exit code
item_prototypes.description: Last Docker container exit code reported by Dockhand for container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in environment "{#ENV.NAME}". The value is null when no exit code is currently available.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Health
item_prototypes.description: Current Docker health status reported by Dockhand for container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in environment "{#ENV.NAME}". Typical values are healthy, unhealthy, starting, or none.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Container ID
item_prototypes.description: Current Docker container ID reported by Dockhand for container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in environment "{#ENV.NAME}". The ID is diagnostic metadata only and is not used as the logical identity of the monitored container.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Image
item_prototypes.description: Docker image name and tag currently used by container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}". Changes to this value may indicate a container image update or redeployment.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Raw data
item_prototypes.description: Collects the current state and metadata of container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" from Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}". This is a master item for dependent container metrics. The raw JSON value is not stored in history.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Restart count
item_prototypes.description: Docker restart counter reported by Dockhand for container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in environment "{#ENV.NAME}". This metric is used to detect repeated container restarts and restart loops.

trigger_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Restart loop detected
trigger_prototypes.description: Container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}" restarted at least {$DOCKHAND.RESTART.COUNT} times within {$DOCKHAND.RESTART.WINDOW}. This may indicate a restart loop or repeated application failures.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: State
item_prototypes.description: Current Docker container state reported by Dockhand for container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in environment "{#ENV.NAME}". Typical values include running, exited, paused, restarting, and created.

item_prototypes.name: Dockhand container {#CONTAINER.NAME}: Status
item_prototypes.description: Human-readable Docker container status reported by Dockhand for container "{#CONTAINER.NAME}" in environment "{#ENV.NAME}". Examples include "Up 10 minutes", "Exited (1) 5 minutes ago", and health status information.

discovery_rules.name: Discover Dockhand environments
discovery_rules.description: Discovers Docker environments configured in Dockhand through the /api/environments endpoint. Supports both unauthenticated Dockhand installations and installations protected by a bearer API token.

trigger_prototypes.name: Dockhand environment {#ENV.NAME}: Offline
trigger_prototypes.description: Dockhand environment "{#ENV.NAME}" is unreachable. The problem is automatically resolved when Dockhand reports the environment online again.

macros.description: Dockhand API bearer token. Leave empty when Dockhand authentication is disabled. Override this macro as Secret text on the monitored host when authentication is enabled.
Interval for Dockhand environment and container low-level discovery.
Name of the local Dockhand application container monitored through the Zabbix Agent 2 Docker plugin.
Interval for collecting current Dockhand container state and metadata.
Number of container restarts within the configured time window required to trigger a restart loop alert.
Time window used to count container restarts when detecting a restart loop.
Base URL of the Dockhand instance. Do not include a trailing slash.

triggers.expression:
last(/Dockhand by HTTP/dockhand.local.container.running)=1
and
count(/Dockhand by HTTP/dockhand.local.container.health,#2,"eq",2)=2
triggers.name: Dockhand application container is unhealthy
triggers.description: The local Dockhand application container health check reports unhealthy.
